description: Evaluation suite for retroactive payroll processing skill

evals.name: Simple Salary Increase Retro
evals.description: Analyze a straightforward salary increase retroactively applied to 5 employees for a single period with clean data.

scenario.change_description: 5% salary increase effective retroactively to January 2024

evaluation_steps: Run analyze_retro_impact.py with current and prior results
Verify exactly 5 affected employees are identified
Confirm all 5 are classified as 'Pay Rate Change'
Verify retro amounts are approximately 5% of salary
Check that /551 wage type differences are present for base salary
Confirm no edge case warnings are generated

evals.name: Complex Multi-Type Retro with Risk Assessment
evals.description: Analyze a complex retroactive scenario with multiple retro types affecting 15 employees, including pay rate changes, organizational reassignments, and tax corrections.

scenario.change_description: Multiple changes: salary increases (5 emp), org reassignments (3 emp), tax corrections (2 emp), benefit change (1 emp), terminated employee correction (1 emp), new hire backdated (1 emp)

evaluation_steps: Run analyze_retro_impact.py with current and prior results
Verify 13 affected employees are identified
Confirm retro type classifications are correct for each scenario
Verify risk assessment correctly identifies High risk (terminated/new hire)
Check GL impact includes accounts for tax, benefits, and salary
Validate edge case warnings for terminated employee and new hire are generated
Verify total retro amount is in expected range
Generate report using generate_retro_report.py
Verify multi-sheet report includes all scenarios

evals.name: Edge Case Scenario with Year Boundary and Terminated Employee
evals.description: Handle a complex scenario with year-boundary crossing and retroactive adjustment for a terminated employee's final pay.

scenario.change_description: Final pay correction for terminated employee (E012) with retroactive vacation payout adjustment; spans Dec 2023-Jan 2024 year boundary

evaluation_steps: Run analyze_retro_impact.py with current and prior results
Verify terminated employee (E012) is identified with correct edge case flags
Confirm risk level is assessed as Critical (due to terminated employee flag)
Validate that vacation payout changes are captured in wage type breakdown
Check that edge case warnings include 'Terminated employee' and 'High-Value Retro' (if applicable)
Verify GL impact accounts for both salary and vacation payout
Generate report and review 'Edge Cases' sheet for detailed warnings
Confirm approval checklist flags this as requiring executive review
Validate retro amount accounts for the vacation payout difference

integration_tests.name: End-to-End Retro Analysis and Reporting
integration_tests.description: Complete workflow: analyze retro impact, then generate comprehensive XLSX report
steps: Verify test_analysis.json contains all expected fields
Verify test_report.xlsx has 7 sheets (Summary, Employee Detail, By Retro Type, GL Impact, Risk Assessment, Edge Cases, Approval Checklist)
Confirm Summary sheet shows correct affected employee count
Confirm Employee Detail sheet has one row per wage type change
Confirm GL Impact sheet lists all affected GL accounts
Confirm Risk Assessment sheet is sorted by risk level
Confirm Edge Cases sheet contains warnings
Confirm Approval Checklist is ready for sign-off

data_quality_notes.test_data_description: Generated test dataset with 50 employees (E001-E050) across 6 departments and 5 cost centers. Each record includes EE_Status field (0=Active, 3=Withdrawn/Terminated) per SAP infotype 0000.
scenarios_included: 1 terminated employee with final pay adjustment (E012)

data_files.prior_results.xlsx: Pre-retro payroll results for all 50 employees
data_files.current_results.xlsx: Post-retro payroll results with deliberate differences
